SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money (Kenyan currency) - Ksh.1 coins, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

1. Look at and talk about the Kenyan sh.1 coin, Learners with speech difficulties could use other alternative modes of communication to share their responses. Ensure safety for all learners.

2. Identify Kenyan sh.1 coins from a variety of Kenyan sh. Coins.

4. Trace Kenyan sh.1 coin, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use any functional part of the body as they do the activity.
